# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-11

This Xteink X4 release fixes the reading-duration summary shown when the device enters sleep.

## Fixed

- Fixed the “I read” sleep summary showing only the most recent reader segment after opening a menu and returning to the book.
- Reading time recorded by all qualifying reader sessions is now retained and combined until the device enters sleep.

## Notes

- The underlying reading-statistics calculation remains unchanged.
- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 only.
